description: Probes the IDTA template map: template numbers, titles and released versions from the official title pages / version histories, and the cardinality and naming changes between template versions that are commonly reported wrongly (Nameplate 3.0, Carbon Footprint 1.0, Handover 2.0, BoM 1.1).

items.question: Which IDTA number is the Capability Description submodel template, and what is its first released version?
What is the latest published version of the Digital Nameplate template (IDTA 02006) in the official repository mirror, and when was it released?

citation.document: IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment
citation.quote: IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment Version 3.0.1 October 2025

items.question: Is YearOfConstruction mandatory in Digital Nameplate 3.0?
items.expected_answer: No. Version 3.0 changed YearOfConstruction from [1] (mandatory) to [0..1] (optional).

citation.document: IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment
citation.section: Annex: Changes Version 2.0 to 3.0, major changes

items.question: In Digital Nameplate 3.0, what is the manufacturer's contact/address SMC called: ContactInformation or something else?
items.expected_answer: AddressInformation: the SMC ContactInformation was renamed to AddressInformation and is now defined by the SMT drop-in Address Information.

citation.document: IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment
citation.section: Annex: Changes Version 2.0 to 3.0, major changes
citation.quote: SMC "ContactInformation" was renamed to "AddressInformation" and is now defined by a drop-in from SMT drop-in "Address Information"

items.question: Is OrderCodeOfManufacturer optional in Digital Nameplate 3.0, as it was in 2.0?
items.expected_answer: No. Version 3.0 changed OrderCodeOfManufacturer from [0..1] (optional) to [1] (mandatory).

citation.document: IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment
citation.section: Annex: Changes Version 2.0 to 3.0, major changes

items.question: Does the released IDTA 02023 Carbon Footprint v1.0 template still model a Transport Carbon Footprint (TCF)?
items.expected_answer: No. Version 1.0 removed the Transport Carbon Footprint (it remains a product carbon footprint template).

items.question: Which ECLASS release do the IRDIs in IDTA 02023 Carbon Footprint v1.0 come from?
items.expected_answer: ECLASS 15 (v1.0 updated them from ECLASS 13 IRDIs).

citation.quote: Update from ECLASS 13 IRDIs to ECLASS 15

items.question: Is IDTA 02004 Handover Documentation 2.0 (June 2025) the latest published version of that template?
items.expected_answer: No. A bug-fix version 2.0.1 of IDTA 02004 was released on 2025-11-03 (November 2025).

citation.quote: 2025-11-03 2.0.1 Release of the bug fix version of the Submodel template published by IDTA

items.question: Was IDTA 02008 Time Series Data version 1.0 ever officially published, or is 1.1 the first official release?
items.expected_answer: 1.0 was used for development only and never officially published; 1.1 (March 2023) is the first official IDTA release.

citation.quote: 1.0 Used for development only. No official version published. 2023-03-01 1.1 Release of the official Submodel template published by IDTA.

items.question: Which version of IDTA 02011 Hierarchical Structures enabling Bills of Material targets AAS Metamodel V3, and is it guaranteed backward compatible with 1.0?
items.expected_answer: Version 1.1; it is the adaptation to Metamodel Version 3 and may contain breaking changes, so backward compatibility with 1.0 is not guaranteed.

citation.document: IDTA 02011 Hierarchical Structures enabling Bills of Material
citation.file: idta-pdfs:txt/published/Hierarchical Structures enabling Bills of Material/1/1/IDTA 02011-1-1_Submodel_HierarchicalStructuresEnablingBoM.txt
citation.quote: Adaptation to Asset Administration Shell Metamodel Version 3. May contain breaking changes corresponding to the Metamodel.

items.question: Which IDTA template number and part carries the Digital Battery Passport's nameplate data?
items.expected_answer: IDTA 02035-1, Digital Battery Passport Part 1 Digital Nameplate (February 2026).

citation.document: IDTA 02035-1 Digital Battery Passport - Part 1 Digital Nameplate
citation.quote: IDTA 02035-1: Digital Battery Passport – Part 1 Digital Nameplate February 2026

items.question: What is IDTA 02099-1 and when was it released?
items.expected_answer: IDTA 02099-1 Digital Product Passport - Part 1 Metadata (DppMetadata), released May 2026.

citation.document: IDTA 02099-1 Digital Product Passport - Part 1 Metadata
citation.file: idta-pdfs:txt/published/Digital Product Passport/Digital Product Passport Part-1/1/0/0/IDTA 02099-1_Submodel Digital Product Passport - Part 1.txt
citation.quote: IDTA 02099-1: Digital Product Passport - Part 1 Metadata May 2026

items.question: Which IDTA submodel template declares data retention policies, and which version is published?
items.expected_answer: IDTA 02056 Data Retention Policies, version 1.0 (IDTA 02056-1-0, June 2024).

items.question: Is IDTA 02003 Technical Data version 2.0 (March 2025) the latest published release?
items.expected_answer: No. A bug-fix version 2.0.1 was released in November 2025 (03-11-2025).

citation.document: IDTA 02003 Generic Frame for Technical Data for Industrial Equipment in Manufacturing
citation.quote: 03-11-2025 2.0.1 Release of the bug fix version of the Submodel template published by IDTA

items.question: Is version 1.1 (April 2026) still the latest released version of IDTA 02017 Asset Interfaces Description?
items.expected_answer: No. Version 1.2 was released on 05.10.2026 (after 1.0 in January 2024 and 1.1 in April 2026).

citation.quote: 05.10.2026 1.2 Release of the official Submodel template published by IDTA.
